title: Esri MOOC: Cartography
description: Advanced cartography with ArcGIS Pro, symbology, projections, 3D & animation.
fullText: Completed Esri’s prestigious 6-week MOOC on Cartography, mastering symbology standards, projection systems, and 3D terrain modeling. Built animated, data-rich map visualizations using ArcGIS Pro and refined spatial analysis workflows. Applying these skills to produce clear, compelling maps that communicate complex spatial stories.
